outcome: risk of developing gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
cohort: 149 pregnant women, some diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and some without, from Northern Greece.
finding: Women with GDM exhibited greater increases in BMI and weight gain between 28 and 35 weeks, while higher BMI at 28 weeks and weight gain within IOM guidelines up to 28 weeks were associated with reduced odds of developing GDM.
